# IT-Guru.Online — Workspace Instructions

## Project Overview
This is the **IT-Guru.Online** website project — an automated platform for domain registration, client onboarding, quotations, and IT services based in Kuils River, South Africa.

## Partnership
- **IT-Guru Online** — Hosting, domain registration, IT support, infrastructure
- **Swift Designz** — Website development and design

## Core Features
1. Domain Availability Checker (real-time with alternatives)
2. Online Client Registration Form (multi-step wizard)
3. Automated Quotation System
4. Contact Form with notifications
5. Blog / News Section
6. Portfolio / Gallery
7. Light / Dark Theme Toggle
8. SEO Optimisation

## Coding Standards
- TypeScript throughout
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- Mobile-first responsive design
- WCAG AA accessibility compliance
- Environment variables for all secrets
- Server-side validation on all forms
- POPIA (South African data protection) compliance
